hemibrain:v1.2.1.description:
A reconstructon of the female central complex and surrounding neuropils from the Janelia FlyEM Team Project and Google Connectomics.
Covers roughly half of the brain, with ~22k fully reconstructed neurons and ~76k truncated neurons.

- [Project overview](https://www.janelia.org/project-team/flyem/hemibrain)
- Companion sites:
    - [Base neuroglancer scene](https://neuroglancer-demo.appspot.com/#!gs://flyem-views/hemibrain/v1.2/base.json)
    - [Clio](https://clio.janelia.org)
- Citation: [Scheffer et al. (2020)](https://doi.org/10.7554/eLife.57443)

manc:v1.2.3.description:
The MANC connectome from the Janelia FlyEM Team Project and the Cambridge Drosophila Connectomics Group, and Google Connectomics.
The male adult Drosophila nerve cord; 23k neurons.

- [Project overview](https://www.janelia.org/project-team/flyem/manc-connectome)
- Companion sites:
    - [Base neuroglancer scene](https://neuroglancer-demo.appspot.com/#!gs://manc-seg-v1p2/manc-v1.2.3-neuprint-layers.json)
    - [Clio](https://clio.janelia.org)
- Citations
    - [Takemura et al. (2024)](https://doi.org/10.7554/eLife.97769.1)
    - [Marin et al. (2024)](https://doi.org/10.7554/eLife.97766.1)
    - [Cheong et al. (2025)](https://doi.org/10.7554/eLife.96084.2)

mushroombody.description:
A reconstruction of the fly alpha lobe in the mushroom body, with 983 neurons.

- Citation: [Takemura et al. (2017)](https://doi.org/10.7554/eLife.26975)
